function boom(value: number): string { throw new Error(String(value)); }
function nestedExpression() {
  let x: string | number = 'hi';
  try { x = boom(x = 1); } catch { x.toUpperCase(); }
}
function nestedBlock() {
  let x: string | number = 'hi';
  try { if (true) { x = 1; x = 'bye'; } } catch { x.toUpperCase(); }
}
function finallyIntermediate() {
  let x: string | number = 'hi';
  try { x = 1; x = 'bye'; } finally { x.toUpperCase(); }
}
function nestedEmptyFinally() {
  let x: string | number = 'hi';
  try { try { x = 1; throw 0; } finally {} } catch { x.toUpperCase(); }
}
function nestedFinallyIntermediate() {
  let x: string | number = 'hi';
  try { try { x = 1; throw 0; } finally { x = 2; x = 'ok'; } } catch { x.toUpperCase(); }
}
function catchIntermediate() {
  let x: string | number = 'hi';
  try { throw 0; } catch { x = 1; x = 'ok'; } finally { x.toUpperCase(); }
}
function destructured() {
  let x: string | number = 'hi';
  try { ({value: x} = {value: 1}); x = 'ok'; } catch { x.toUpperCase(); }
}
function defaulted(input: {value?: string}) {
  let x: string | number = 'hi';
  let y = '';
  try { ({value: y = boom(x = 1)} = input); } catch { x.toUpperCase(); }
}
function loop(flag: boolean) {
  let x: string | number = 'hi';
  try { while (flag) { x = 1; x = 'ok'; flag = false; } } catch { x.toUpperCase(); }
}
function inlineFinally() {
  let x: string | number = 'hi';
  try { (() => { x = 1; })(); } finally { x.toUpperCase(); }
}
